messages:
anya (design): dropping a quick thread about the compare toolbar + filter chips in the catalog. prototype: https://img.redwood.dev/s/compare-toolbar-compact.gif

sam (design): love the simplified toolbar. question: should filter chips collapse into a "More" dropdown once there are >4 active filters? feels noisy on small widths.

riley (pm): yes please. product perspective: we need filters to be discoverable during trial flows. if collapsed, show a counter like "3 filters" that expands on click.

tanya (eng): implement note: if we do collapse, prefer CSS-only collapse for perf and avoid remounting the whole list. also sticky toolbar on scroll might need z-index tweaks.

noah (a11y): accessibility: collapsed button must have aria-expanded and a clear label, e.g., "Show active filters (3)". also ensure keyboard users can open and type to remove chips.

anya (design): proposal: chips show icon + short label, and hovering reveals full filter text in a tooltip. on small screens chips become compact with an ellipsis.

sam (design): for performance badges i want stronger separation between latency vs cost vs stability. maybe use micro-icons: a clock, a $ symbol, and a shield. but color coding needs a legend.

riley (pm): +1 on legend. also can we make the compare table support column pinning? engineering ask: pin "perf" and "latency" columns by default for new users.

tanya (eng): we can support column pinning client-side with virtualized table. default pinned columns okay, but we should persist user preference in localStorage and sync to profile later.

noah (a11y): pinned columns should not trap keyboard navigation. ensure tab order follows DOM reading order; use aria-colindex properly.

anya (design): copy suggestion for the legend: "Badge legend: latency (ms), cost (tokens/$), stability (regressions)" short and scannable.

sam (design): small copy nit: replace "stability" with "reliability" in UI copy. clearer for non-ML folks.

riley (pm): agreed. replace across mocks and help text.

tanya (eng): one more engineering constraint: icons in badges increase DOM nodes; recommend a single sprite/svg sheet to keep bundle small.

product-bot: created ticket UI-1323: "Catalog: filter collapse + badge legend + column pinning + a11y follow-ups" and assigned to @anya (design), @tanya (eng), @noah (a11y).

anya (design): thanks everyone. I'll update artboards to show collapsed state, legend placement (top-right), and pin affordance. posting updated gif in the ticket by EOD. :sparkles:
